A heritage quest for a new generation
Our vision

Make every heritage visit more engaging—and more responsible.

YathraLanka connects heritage, learning and technology. It transforms a visit into a guided experience: visitors discover a place, verify their presence, learn its story and reflect on how careful behaviour can help protect it. Our long-term vision is to bring this approach beyond Sri Lanka, creating thoughtful heritage experiences for communities and travellers around the world.

Connect

Bring visitors closer to the stories, people and significance behind cultural places.

Gamify with purpose

Use guided challenges and learning activities to make exploration memorable, informed and enjoyable.

Encourage care

Promote respectful visiting habits that support the preservation of heritage for future generations.

Grow globally

Begin with Sri Lankan heritage and build a model that can be adapted for cultural sites worldwide.

VisionEX Grand Finale

Celebrating young innovators at IIT.

VisionEX is a showcase of innovation and technology by school students from the Colombo District, organised by the Informatics Institute of Technology. We are delighted to present YathraLanka at the Grand Finale and award ceremony.
